grid: ReviewReval round-96 independent reval grid (24 cases, contract v1 + RFC 9111 s4.3)

cases.name: construct/lm-zero-no-etag
cases.grounding: lane-convention (SHOULD treated as sent; boundary value 0 must not be dropped by a falsy check)
cases.quote: SHOULD send the Last-Modified value (using If-Modified-Since) if the request is not for a subrange, a single stored response is being validated, and that response contains a Last-Modified value
cases.note: zero last_modified is the falsy-trap boundary; RFC 9111 leaves the SHOULD's subrange condition unrepresentable over supplied values, so sending is the labeled lane convention

cases.name: construct/etag-single-obtext
cases.quote: entity-tag = [ weak ] opaque-tag / weak = %s"W/" / opaque-tag = DQUOTE *etagc DQUOTE / etagc = %x21 / %x23-7E / obs-text (RFC 9110 sec 8.8.3, retained round-81 body lines 3579-3585; RFC example: ETag: "")
cases.note: entity-tag whose opaque part is a single obs-text byte U+0086

cases.name: construct/weak-obtext-both
cases.grounding: rfc-exact (MUST send tags verbatim, weak marker is part of the tag) + lane-convention (both fields together)
cases.quote: MUST send the relevant entity tags (using If-Match, If-None-Match, or If-Range) if the entity tags were provided in the stored response(s) being validated
cases.note: weak marker W/ is case-sensitive and carried verbatim

cases.name: construct/empty-opaque-tag
cases.grounding: rfc-exact (etagc grammar: *etagc allows zero etagc, so "" is a well-formed entity-tag)
cases.quote: entity-tag = [ weak ] opaque-tag / weak = %s"W/" / opaque-tag = DQUOTE *etagc DQUOTE / etagc = %x21 / %x23-7E / obs-text (RFC 9110 sec 8.8.3, retained round-81 body lines 3579-3585; RFC example: ETag: "")
cases.note: a candidate that demands non-empty opaque content over-refuses a grammar-valid tag

cases.name: construct/exists-false-no-validators
cases.grounding: contract-definition (C1 keys on validators; C6 refusal list has no entry for exists=false without validators at construction stage)
cases.quote: MUST send the relevant entity tags (using If-Match, If-None-Match, or If-Range) if the entity tags were provided in the stored response(s) being validated
cases.note: negative cacheability shape; no validator means no conditional request is constructible

cases.name: construct/lm-huge
cases.grounding: lane-convention (supplied values: non-negative integer, no ceiling; the lane never parses HTTP dates)
cases.quote: SHOULD send the Last-Modified value (using If-Modified-Since) if the request is not for a subrange, a single stored response is being validated, and that response contains a Last-Modified value
cases.note: year-9999 epoch value; contract fixes no upper bound

cases.name: c304/etag-only
cases.quote: A 304 (Not Modified) response status code indicates that the stored response can be updated and reused
cases.note: 304 indication holds for any stored validator shape

cases.name: c304/lm-zero
cases.quote: A 304 (Not Modified) response status code indicates that the stored response can be updated and reused
cases.note: 304 with only-LM stored, LM value zero

cases.name: c5xx/500-etag-only
cases.quote: if a cache receives a 5xx (Server Error) response while attempting to validate a response, it can either forward this response to the requesting client or act as if the server failed to respond
cases.note: lower edge of the 5xx class

cases.name: c5xx/501-both
cases.quote: if a cache receives a 5xx (Server Error) response while attempting to validate a response, it can either forward this response to the requesting client or act as if the server failed to respond
cases.note: both validators stored; decision is status-driven

cases.name: c5xx/599-lm-only
cases.quote: if a cache receives a 5xx (Server Error) response while attempting to validate a response, it can either forward this response to the requesting client or act as if the server failed to respond
cases.note: upper edge of the 5xx class, LM-only

cases.name: c4xx/299-both
cases.quote: A full response (i.e., one containing content) indicates that none of the stored responses nominated in the conditional request are suitable.  Instead, the cache MUST use the full response to satisfy the request.
cases.note: just below 3xx; status-only class boundary

cases.name: c4xx/300-lm-only
cases.quote: A full response (i.e., one containing content) indicates that none of the stored responses nominated in the conditional request are suitable.  Instead, the cache MUST use the full response to satisfy the request.
cases.note: a redirect status is still the full-response class here

cases.name: c4xx/200-etag-only
cases.grounding: lane-convention over the class membership; rfc-exact that a full response MUST be used once it is one
cases.quote: A full response (i.e., one containing content) indicates that none of the stored responses nominated in the conditional request are suitable.  Instead, the cache MUST use the full response to satisfy the request.
cases.note: plain 200 with only an etag stored

cases.name: c4xx/499-both
cases.quote: A full response (i.e., one containing content) indicates that none of the stored responses nominated in the conditional request are suitable.  Instead, the cache MUST use the full response to satisfy the request.
cases.note: upper edge of the full-response class

cases.name: c4xx/204-lm-only
cases.grounding: lane-convention, explicitly the contract's named exclusion (payload-less 204 is invisible to supplied values)
cases.quote: A full response (i.e., one containing content) indicates that none of the stored responses nominated in the conditional request are suitable.  Instead, the cache MUST use the full response to satisfy the request.
cases.note: RFC-exactly a 204 carries no content, so the bullet's 'full response' reading is the lane's, properly labeled

cases.name: refuse/status-200-exists-false-no-validator
cases.grounding: contract-definition (received_status present while no validator is stored)
cases.note: the exchange presupposes a conditional request, which needs a validator

cases.name: refuse/exists-false-etag
cases.grounding: contract-definition (validators present while exists is false)
cases.note: an absent representation cannot carry a validator

cases.name: refuse/etag-empty-string
cases.quote: entity-tag = [ weak ] opaque-tag / weak = %s"W/" / opaque-tag = DQUOTE *etagc DQUOTE / etagc = %x21 / %x23-7E / obs-text (RFC 9110 sec 8.8.3, retained round-81 body lines 3579-3585; RFC example: ETag: "")
cases.note: zero-length string is not [weak] DQUOTE *etagc DQUOTE; distinct from the grammar-valid two-DQUOTE empty opaque tag

cases.name: refuse/etag-space-inner
cases.quote: entity-tag = [ weak ] opaque-tag / weak = %s"W/" / opaque-tag = DQUOTE *etagc DQUOTE / etagc = %x21 / %x23-7E / obs-text (RFC 9110 sec 8.8.3, retained round-81 body lines 3579-3585; RFC example: ETag: "")
cases.note: 0x20 is not etagc (0x21 and 0x23-0x7E are); SP boundary

cases.name: refuse/status-199
cases.grounding: rfc-exact ground (1xx is the interim class, never a validation response)
cases.note: upper edge of the 1xx refusal range

cases.name: refuse/lm-bool-true
cases.grounding: contract-definition (last_modified neither null nor a non-negative integer; JSON true is not a number)
cases.note: Python bool-is-int trap; is_int must exclude bool

cases.name: refuse/raw-dup-exists-nested
cases.note: duplicate "exists" key inside the stored object; values differ, refusal must not silently last-win

cases.name: refuse/raw-dup-stored-top
cases.note: duplicate "stored" key at top level
cases.payload: {"stored": {"exists": true, "etag": null, "last_modified": null}, "stored": {"exists": true, "etag": null, "last_modified": null}, "received_status": null}
